title: Code and data for: Contextual Importance and Utility: Separating Climatic Drivers from Limiting Factors in Species Distribution Models for Bird Conservation
description:
Code, processed data, fitted models and results for the article "Contextual Importance and Utility: Separating Climatic Drivers from Limiting Factors in Species Distribution Models for Bird Conservation" (submitted to Journal for Nature Conservation).

Code: MIT License. Models, results and figures: CC BY 4.0. Occurrence records from GBIF.org (accessed 23 April 2026) remain under the licences of their original publishers (see LICENSE-DATA.md). WorldClim 2.1 rasters are not included; step 1 downloads them.
